product.title: Web Of Bugs
product.description:
An Atari 2600-style arcade game where you play as a hungry spider, fighting to survive the relentless waves of insects invading your web at night.
🕷️ Survive, Hunt, and Weave! * Every time you throw a web, you lose a portion of your web (bottom bar). * Hit a bug with your web to turn it into a cocoon. * Eat cocoons to regain the web and stay in the fight. * Bugs that collide with a cocoon also get trapped—use this to your advantage!

history.text: Game developed in 3 hours for Trijam #307 (https://itch.io/jam/trijam-307.). Theme: "Web Of Issues"
The game was brought to life with C# and Blazor WebAssembly, powered by my own game engine, Blazorame!
